column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other (only 1 is "one" in Hindi).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels, in standard Hindi
# (Devanagari) with neutral imperative forms; common software terms (इंस्टॉल, अपडेट, डाउनलोड,
# संस्करण) in their everyday Hindi-IT spellings.
# Coverage: the whole interface: every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# name "Craft App Suite", app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft,
# VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft,
# Trailing "…" (U+2026) must be preserved. Placeholders must appear in the translation.
